title: Periodic compliance archive exports with residency-aware routing
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Goal: Ship a scheduled export service that produces periodic compliance archives (CSV and PDF) and routes them according to tenant data residency settings. This feature will be tenant-aware, respect retention windows and deletion policies, and provide secure automated delivery and an evidence dashboard tile for auditors.

Problem statement: Customers in regulated industries require periodic evidence bundles for audits and internal compliance reviews. Existing one-off exports are manual, error-prone, and do not consistently honor per-tenant residency and retention settings. They also lack tamper-evident manifests and a reliable delivery mechanism to customer-controlled endpoints.

Scope:
- UI + API for creating recurring export schedules (daily/weekly/monthly) and ad-hoc runs.
- Export formats: CSV for raw rows, PDF for packaged summaries (signed manifest with hash).
- Residency-aware routing: Exports must only include records that are allowed to leave the designated region; when tenant residency requires in-region artifacts, route delivery to customer-managed S3 buckets in that region or produce on-prem package.
- Retention and filter controls: Schedule should be able to apply retention cutoffs and include an option to include/exclude deleted or masked records based on tenant policy.
- Delivery targets: S3 (cross-account), SFTP, secure email with signed link, and console download. Support retries and backoff.
- Security: AES-256 encryption at rest, signed manifest (SHA256) and envelope key rotation. Audit trail for every export run.
- Observability: Per-schedule success/failure metrics, cost estimate per run, and a dashboard tile in Console under Compliance -> Evidence Exports.
- Admin controls: RBAC for who can create schedules vs who can execute/download.

Out of scope for this ticket: Full eDiscovery tooling and multi-tenant consolidated bundles across residency boundaries (will be handled by a follow-up orchestration piece).
acceptance_criteria: API to create/update/delete scheduled exports with schedule cron or human-friendly selection
UI flow in Console to create a schedule with residency, retention, format, and delivery target settings
Exports produced in CSV and PDF with checksums and signed manifest attached
Exports only include data permitted by tenant residency and retention policies (automated region routing)
Delivery targets S3 (cross-account), SFTP, and email links succeed with retries and generate delivery receipts
Audit log entry created for every run with status, size, region, and responsible actor
Dashboard tile shows last run, next scheduled run, run duration, and failure reason (if any)
Automated test coverage for residency routing and retention enforcement (unit + integration), plus an e2e smoke test using a staging tenant
Security review completed and documented; encryption key rotation and manifest signing validated
tasks: PM: finalize UI wireframes and acceptance criteria with Design and Eng
Design: deliver high-fidelity mocks for schedule creation and evidence dashboard tile
Eng: implement schedule API, export generator, residency filter layer, and delivery adapters
Eng: add audit log events and telemetry (metrics + tracing) for export jobs
Security: threat model and KMS/HSM integration for envelope encryption
QA: integration tests for S3/SFTP/email delivery and retention enforcement
Docs: public docs and admin guide covering configuration, residency implications, and troubleshooting
Release: beta rollout to 3 existing enterprise tenants with compliance teams for validation
